kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are [your] masters
note: douloi are slaves; "servants" (also Col 3:22, 1 Pet 2:18) softens the institution Paul is addressing.

kjv: against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places
mine: against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places
note: kosmokratoras are cosmic powers; "en tois epouraniois" is "in the heavenly places" (1:3, 1:20, 2:6, 3:10), not "high places" (which suggests human rulers).
TR adds "Amen"; and "en aphtharsia" is "in incorruptibility", which the KJV renders "in sincerity".
